lines.text: Not explain me. Explain it to me!
Many learners say: Can you explain me this word?
Better: Can you explain this word to me?
To me! Please explain it to me.

data.wrong: Can you explain me this word?
data.right: Can you explain this word to me?

native.tip: Nhiều bạn nói “explain me”, nhưng tiếng Anh cần “to”: “explain it to me.”
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “Can you explain me this word?” không? 😅 Phải có “to”: “Can you explain this word to me?” Nghe thầy Carlos đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “to me.” Nhờ bạn bè giải thích một từ bằng “Can you explain… to me?” nhé. Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.tip: Many learners say “explain me,” but English needs “to”: “explain it to me.”
en.caption: Do you often say this? “Can you explain me this word?” You need “to”: “Can you explain this word to me?” Listen to Carlos read it, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
